bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
base=/mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos
mountpoint -q /mnt/g || exit 21
test -d "$base" || exit 22
unit="$(systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -i 'thegreatolddaysofnippongv' | head -1)"
if [ -z "$unit" ]; then
 unit="$(systemctl --user list-units --type=service --all --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -i 'thegreatolddaysofnippongv' | head -1)"
fi
[ -n "$unit" ] || exit 23
[ "$(systemctl --user is-active "$unit" 2>/dev/null)" = active ] || exit 24
pid="$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null)"
[ "$pid" -gt 1 ] 2>/dev/null || exit 25
kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || exit 26
n="$(find "$base" -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -iname '*.mp4' -o -iname '*.mkv' -o -iname '*.mov' -o -iname '*.webm' \) 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
printf 'TARGET_COLLECTOR=ACTIVE\nPID=%s\nROOT_VIDEO_FILES=%s\n' "$pid" "$n"
find "$base" -maxdepth 6 -type f -iname '*783*' -printf 'ID783_FILE_SIZE=%s\n' 2>/dev/null | head -5
exit 0
